title: The Spice Factor
openingText: The factor's stall is an island of lacquered order in the steaming chaos of the port: saffron in brass tins, ledgers squared, a guard pretending to be a porter. 'Sit, sit. Saffron, escorts, secrets... everything is for sale on this coast, wizard. The only question is the price.'
dialogueWalkaway: We are DONE here. The Combine will remember the discourtesy.
dialogueAccept: Pleasure doing business. The Combine keeps its ink dry and its word wet.
confidence: The sloop sails whether you take the berth or not. Corvo is short a crew, not a cargo.

clauses.text: Charts of the drowned harbor and the mangrove passes: twelve hexes of coast, and the sunken customs house marked
A bulk contract on eastern saffron for the guild kitchens and alchemists
A berth on the Combine's next sloop: Tidewrack harbor becomes a supply anchor this run
A customs seal of the Combine: their patrols lose your trail, and the Combine remembers your name
Your wizards guard his next caravan to Tidewrack, unpaid
Your tide tables for the coast, copied fair
Exclusive dealing with the Combine this cycle
The guild owes the Combine one unnamed favor, on demand
